objective: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.

description: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.
Ogron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.
completion: Hmph. It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound.
It seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.
